verses.en: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
verses.zh: 论尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鸿所得的默示。

words.g: the + an Elkoshite or native of Elkosh

verses.en: The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.
verses.zh: 耶和华是忌邪施报的神。耶和华施报大有忿怒；向他的敌人施报，向他的仇敌怀怒。

words.g: and + to grudge, i.e. avenge or punish
to grudge, i.e. avenge or punish
to grudge, i.e. avenge or punish

verses.en: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
verses.zh: 耶和华不轻易发怒，大有能力，万不以有罪的为无罪。他乘旋风和暴风而来，云彩为他脚下的尘土。

words.g: and + a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud

verses.en: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.
verses.zh: 他斥责海，使海干了，使一切江河干涸。巴珊和迦密的树林衰残；黎巴嫩的花草也衰残了。

words.g: to parch  i.e.  to desolate, destroy
Bashan , a region East of the Jordan
and + Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine
Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine

verses.en: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.
verses.zh: 大山因他震动；小山也都消化。大地在他面前突起；世界和住在其间的也都如此。

verses.en: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.
verses.zh: 他发忿恨，谁能立得住呢？他发烈怒，谁能当得起呢？他的忿怒如火倾倒；磐石因他崩裂。

words.g: strictly froth at the mouth, i.e.  fury + +him/his/it

verses.en: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
verses.zh: 耶和华本为善，在患难的日子为人的保障，并且认得那些投靠他的人。

verses.en: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
verses.zh: 但他必以涨溢的洪水淹没尼尼微，又驱逐仇敌进入黑暗。

verses.en: What do you plot against the LORD? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.
verses.zh: 尼尼微人哪，设何谋攻击耶和华呢？他必将你们灭绝净尽；灾难不再兴起。

verses.en: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.
verses.zh: 你们像丛杂的荆棘，像喝醉了的人，又如枯干的碎秸全然烧灭。

words.g: to quaff to satiety, i.e. become tipsy

verses.en: One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.
verses.zh: 有一人从你那里出来，图谋邪恶，设恶计攻击耶和华。

verses.en: The LORD says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：尼尼微虽然势力充足，人数繁多，也被剪除，归于无有。犹大啊，我虽然使你受苦，却不再使你受苦。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”
verses.zh: 现在我必从你颈项上折断他的轭，扭开他的绳索。

verses.en: The LORD has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”
verses.zh: 耶和华已经出令，指着尼尼微说：你名下的人必不留后；我必从你神的庙中除灭雕刻的偶像和铸造的偶像；我必因你鄙陋，使你归于坟墓。

words.g: and + a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal

verses.en: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.
verses.zh: 看哪，有报好信传平安之人的脚登山，说：犹大啊，可以守你的节期，还你所许的愿吧！因为那恶人不再从你中间经过，他已灭绝净尽了。

words.g: to be fresh, i.e. full  cheerful)
to move in acircle, i.e.  to march in asacred procession
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
a festival, or a victim therefor + +you/your

verses.en: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!
verses.zh: 尼尼微啊，那打碎邦国的上来攻击你。你要看守保障，谨防道路，使腰强壮，大大勉力。

words.g: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively
to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one
a hemming in, i.e.  a mound
to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance
the waist or small of the back
to be alert, physically  or mentally

verses.en: For the LORD restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel, for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches.
verses.zh: （耶和华复兴雅各的荣华，好像以色列的荣华一样；因为使地空虚的，已经使雅各和以色列空虚，将他们的葡萄枝毁坏了。）

words.g: to pour out, i.e. to empty + +them/their
to pour out, i.e. to empty

verses.en: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.
verses.zh: 他勇士的盾牌是红的，精兵都穿朱红衣服。在他预备争战的日子，战车上的钢铁闪烁如火，柏木把的枪也抡起来了。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men
to crimson, i.e. dye that color

verses.en: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.
verses.zh: 车辆在街上（或译：城外）急行，在宽阔处奔来奔去，形状如火把，飞跑如闪电。

words.g: in + separate by awall, i.e. outside
in + a width, i.e.  avenue or area
like + a flambeau, lamp or flame

verses.en: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.
verses.zh: 尼尼微王招聚他的贵胄；他们步行绊跌，速上城墙，预备挡牌。

words.g: to be liquid or flow easily, i.e

verses.en: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.
verses.zh: 河闸开放，宫殿冲没。

verses.en: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
verses.zh: 王后蒙羞，被人掳去；宫女捶胸，哀鸣如鸽。此乃命定之事。

words.g: and + to station, in various applications
and + a maidservant or female slave + +her/its
to drum, i.e. play  on the tambourine

verses.en: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.
verses.zh: 尼尼微自古以来充满人民，如同聚水的池子；现在居民却都逃跑。虽有人呼喊说：站住！站住！却无人回顾。

verses.en: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
verses.zh: 你们抢掠金银吧！因为所积蓄的无穷，华美的宝器无数。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.
verses.zh: 尼尼微现在空虚荒凉，人心消化，双膝相碰，腰都疼痛，脸都变色。

words.g: the waist or small of the back

verses.en: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked with the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?
verses.zh: 狮子的洞和少壮狮子喂养之处在哪里呢？公狮母狮小狮游行、无人惊吓之地在哪里呢？

words.g: a cub , especially of the lion

verses.en: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey.
verses.zh: 公狮为小狮撕碎许多食物，为母狮掐死活物，把撕碎的、掐死的充满它的洞穴。

words.g: in + enough , used chiefly with preposition in phrases
prey, i.e. flocks devoured by animals

verses.en: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
verses.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「我与你为敌，必将你的车辆焚烧成烟，刀剑也必吞灭你的少壮狮子。我必从地上除灭你所撕碎的，你使者的声音必不再听见。」

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.
verses.zh: 祸哉！这流人血的城，充满谎诈和强暴―抢夺的事总不止息。

words.g: a failure of flesh, i.e. emaciation

verses.en: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,
verses.zh: 鞭声响亮，车轮轰轰，马匹踢跳，车辆奔腾，

words.g: to stamp, i.e. to spring about

verses.en: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies
verses.zh: 马兵争先，刀剑发光，枪矛闪烁，被杀的甚多，尸首成了大堆，尸骸无数，人碰着而跌倒，

words.g: a carcase , whether of man or beast
to + a body, whether alive or dead
in + a body, whether alive or dead + +them/their

verses.en: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.
verses.zh: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行，惯行邪术，藉淫行诱惑列国，用邪术诱惑（原文是卖）多族。

words.g: and + a family, i.e. circle of relatives

verses.en: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.
verses.zh: 万军之耶和华说：我与你为敌；我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你脸上，使列国看见你的赤体，使列邦观看你的丑陋。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
a nude place, i.e.  the pudenda + +you/your
and + dominion, i.e.  the estate  or  the country

verses.en: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.
verses.zh: 我必将可憎污秽之物抛在你身上，辱没你，为众目所观。

words.g: like + sight, whether abstractly  or concretely

verses.en: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”
verses.zh: 凡看见你的，都必逃跑离开你，说：尼尼微荒凉了！有谁为你悲伤呢？我何处寻得安慰你的人呢？

verses.en: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?
verses.zh: 你岂比挪亚们强呢？挪亚们坐落在众河之间，周围有水；海（指尼罗河）作她的濠沟，又作她的城墙。

words.g: from + No , the capital of Upper Egypt
in + a channel, e.g. a fosse

verses.en: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.
verses.zh: 古实和埃及是她无穷的力量；弗人和路比族是她的帮手。

words.g: Cush , the name of a son of Ham
and + Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
and + a Libyan or inhabitant of interior Africa

verses.en: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
verses.zh: 但她被迁移，被掳去；她的婴孩在各市口上也被摔死。人为她的尊贵人拈阄；她所有的大人都被链子锁着。

words.g: in + what leaps forth, i.e. flash of fire

verses.en: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
verses.zh: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏，并因仇敌的缘故寻求避难所。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to veil from sight, i.e. conceal
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.
verses.zh: 你一切保障必像无花果树上初熟的无花果，若一摇撼就落在想吃之人的口中。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to waver, in a great variety of applications
the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.
verses.zh: 你地上的人民如同妇女；你国中的关口向仇敌敞开；你的门闩被火焚烧。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your

verses.en: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.
verses.zh: 你要打水预备受困；要坚固你的保障，踹土和泥，修补砖窑。

words.g: something hemming in, i.e.  a mound
in + a bubbling up, i.e. of water

verses.en: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.
verses.zh: 在那里，火必烧灭你；刀必杀戮你，吞灭你如同蝻子。任你加增人数多如蝻子，多如蝗虫吧！

verses.en: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.
verses.zh: 你增添商贾，多过天上的星；蝻子吃尽而去。

verses.en: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
verses.zh: 你的首领多如蝗虫；你的军长彷佛成群的蚂蚱，天凉的时候齐落在篱笆上，日头一出便都飞去，人不知道落在何处。

words.g: and + to wave to and fro

verses.en: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.
verses.zh: 亚述王啊，你的牧人睡觉；你的贵胄安歇；你的人民散在山间，无人招聚。

words.g: Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?
verses.zh: 你的损伤无法医治；你的伤痕极其重大。凡听你信息的必都因此向你拍掌。你所行的恶谁没有时常遭遇呢？
